# One variable set does not make every key come from the environment. Before
# provenance was per key this scenario answered from=environment for all three,
# and a person following it went looking for a variable that decides nothing.
user {"store":"A","log_sink":"L","log_service":"S"}
# setup 1: ok
env store B
# setup 2: ok
load
# expect 3: ok store=B/environment log_sink=L/user log_service=S/user [CFG-P1]
key log_sink
# expect 4: ok value=L from=user [CFG-P1]
key log_service
# expect 5: ok value=S from=user [CFG-P1]
key store
# expect 6: ok value=B from=environment [CFG-P1]
